resolution.note: judge arm in lane Stop proven by test/hook/outcome-judge.test.ts on verbatim transcript captures with a stubbed judge

title: A lane Stop asks a small-model judge whether the transcript proves the task outcome
body:
Why: operator-shared AI LABS video jlEMo6Dsh9E (Belay, from description only; .krn/sources/videos/jlEMo6Dsh9E.desc.txt): a lane can satisfy every deterministic Stop arm yet not deliver the task Outcome line.
Outcome: the Stop hook in a lane sends the task Outcome and Proof lines plus the last turns to a Haiku judge that answers proven or missing with the missing item; missing refuses Stop once with the item named; KRN_OUTCOME_JUDGE=0 opts out; judge cost is logged per lane.
Files: src/hook/stop.ts, src/cli/hook.ts, tests.
Proof: a Stop test on a verbatim lane transcript capture with the outcome missing refuses naming it, and passes on a capture that proves it.
